कोहड कोहड, अस्, m., N. of a man; [cf.
कौहड and कोहल.]

कोहल कोहल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. को + हल? cf.
कुतूहल), speaking indistinctly; (अस्), m. a kind of
musical instrument; a sort of spirituous liquor; N. of
a saint or Muni, the inventor or first teacher of the
drama, also a writer on music.
कोहलीय, अम्, n. title of Kohala's work on music.
कोहित कोहित, अस्, m., N. of a man.
